title: DECISION: CASE WHEN display_name IS NULL in upsert_discovered_contact
description: On conflict, use SQL CASE to conditionally update display_name: if current value is NULL, fill it from discovery; else preserve the user-customized name. Separates auto-discovered metadata (which may be absent or stale) from user-edited fields. Prevents auto-discovery from overwriting user preferences, while allowing discovery to populate empty fields.
